component.name: Pengu Deck
component.summary: Two deck DJ software with local files and SoundCloud

description.p: Pengu Deck is a lightweight DJ application for Linux. It plays any audio format FFmpeg understands and streams tracks straight from SoundCloud into a deck.

ul.li: Two decks with coloured waveforms, beat grid and scratching
Automatic BPM detection, sync and beat-matched loops
Hot cues and cue points remembered per track
Three band EQ with kills, filter, trim, crossfader curves
Headphone cue via split output or a 4 channel interface
SoundCloud search, links, playlists and your likes

description.p: Keeps the session awake while playing, recording or streaming, lower CPU use through a waveform render cache, automix holds while a deck is paused, Escape closes dialogs, and a fix for a crash when the recording folder cannot be created.

Compact single line track list with artist, album and genre columns, played tracks marked as whole rows, automix transitions sized from the tracks, and a fix for a crash when switching to History or a playlist.
